title: Offer Water Works and cash for New York
description: Offer Water Works and cash for New York. Orange completion is worth a surplus utility and moderate cash. The offer has to be credible to the counterparty while preserving Alpha's actual strategic edge.

final_action.public_message: Hey Beta, I'd love to complete the orange set. I'll give you Water Works and $200 for New York Avenue. Good deal for both!
final_action.private_thought: Acquiring New York Avenue gives me a monopoly on orange, boosting rent potential. Offering Water Works plus cash should be attractive to Beta, who currently holds the other utility.

Private thought names the real strategic goal.
